2019 Seattle Grand Prix: You Don’t Know Who I Am

  • Quote

    Post by stephengascrub » January 20th, 2019, 11:08 pm

    Hey everyone, it’s 6:50 Pacific Coast Time and I’m sitting in an airport and my flight doesn’t leave until 10:40. So what am I doing? Writing a tournament report. I actually have to drive 6 hours for a job interview on Tuesday when I get back, so it’s either now or a lot later.

    I guess I’ll start off by saying I kind of dropped off from playing around 2014-2015 when Chris Baker moved (BFred, insist that he keeps playing and make him your disciple (mostly kidding here) he beat Hayes once!) to Indiana and BHerold switched to the bad SW LCG game. I was also busy finishing my new degree in chemical engineering.

    Come 2018 I graduated, and moved back to Georgia with family while I continue to hunt for an engineering/math/science/tech job.

    Having not gone to a big event in 6 years, I was able to manage to go to either this or Worlds. However, I had just started playing again and felt too rusty for Worlds. So Seattle it was.

    For decks, I struggled a lot but got help from Jeremy, Mike, Gogolen, Hayes, Reid, Emil, and Seth. I was kind of shocked not ATL guys replied, so thanks.

    Ultimately, because Seth is awesome, I started play testing for the event with him. He sold me on BHBM skulls and a bunch of light side decks I passed on. In the meantime Kessling told me I should play MAP and TRM (good calls). I didn’t feel comfortable with MAP and was 50/50 on TRM.

    At a local a while later, Jeremy showed me the cool Diplo/Savrip deck. I like it, but I’m an aggro player at heart. So I waffled on that.

    I could go on, but I feel that this pretty much gives enough background for my prep.

    I left Atlanta Friday and got to the hotel around 3. I end up saying hey to Wirfs and a few guys and then chilled until the team tournament.

    I didn’t have a partner, but Joe Phillips offered to team with me. I ended up playing Hunt Down since I wanted to save skulls and he played this crazy Hidden Base deck with 10 systems.

    Game 1: Us vs. Dennis and Mitch

    I was paired against Dennis’ YOPS and Joe played Mitch’s Huntdown. I didn’t really take notes but know I lost by 17 and Joe won by 30. So we moved on to the next round.

    Game 2: US vs. Jellison and Sersen

    This round I played against Ryan Sersen’s WHAP and took and held onto the throne room right away. Late game I knocked him out of space and won by 18. It was pretty rough for Ryan and the fact it was that close was a testament to his skill level. Joe lost to Jellison’s Invasion by 2, because Tey How is nuts.

    Game 3: Us vs. Team Brian

    Somehow, someway we were in the finals. That’s insane. Could we be team tournament champions? Unfortunately, nope. I played against Hitco and Brian Fred just had the answers. All game. But he took me seriously as an opponent which was cool, because I’m a pseudo-jabroni. In the end he won by 20 something and Bryan M. somehow had Joe’s number with ROPS.

    Anyways even though we finished up short, it was a blast and Joe is an really cool dude.

    No real interesting details that evening so on to the main event.
    I guess I decided on Hitco because I felt teching for ROPS with TRM wouldn’t matter against good players. Only 2 guys would play it as it turned out.

    Game 1: My Hitco vs. Joe Phillip’s SYCFA Tractor Abrams

    This was unfortunately a pretty uneventful game. I stuck to the ground and Joe stuck to space. Mid/late game he went down to Jedha with Palpatine. I grimtaashed him used (yes Hayes, the card is sick) and got ghhhk, so I battled with Han/Leia/Lando and overflowed him for 8. He got out Tarkin Doctrine after but that was game. It felt bad to beat a guy I consider a friend now, but it happens.

    1-0

    Game 2: My BHBM vs. Ryan Sersen’s YOPS

    Ugh. This was not a matchup I wanted. All I have from my notes though were that I had trouble getting Vader’s saber, should have deployed the Finalizer to battle instead of at a lone system and somehow stacked 3 (!) cards. I had at least two chances to win via duel, but both times failed. Great game.

    1-1

    Game 3: My HITCO vs. Mitch’s HD Dueling

    So Mitch and Dennis brought this crazy HD deck with like 6 or 7 duel cards for the epic duel and a bunch of high destiny. Which is horrible for HITCO. But somehow Mitch has really, really, really bad luck. Maybe even epically bad luck. To start, I grimtaash 2 vader’s Obsessions lost. That really set him back and by the time he could do anything I had gotten way ahead with force drains. Mitch still successfully duels Luke and I lose 6 and he joins Vader. Later I get Profundity to Mustafar with Chewie and draw a 5 to clear Mara, and that closes it, since I occupied a bg site and he didn’t occupy a system.

    In the end I won by 10.

    2-1

    Game 4: My BHBM vs Matt Wadden’s OA

    So this was the first game I made a lot of small mistakes. I try to spread to multiple sites like I did versus Seth in play testing, but Matt kicks me off, and got two ships to Jakku before I could contest the system and that was all she wrote. I think I should have consolidated and tried to attack Matt on the ground, but oh well. That said he is a strong player and played well, so he earned the win. Probably by 25-ish?

    2-2

    Game 5: My BHBM vs Krueger’s OA

    This time after getting advice from Matt I played this well. I don’t think I made any mistakes against Kyle. But I just couldn’t win. I had 38 power to his 22 at Jakku and he lost the irrelevant guys to attrition and peeled 5 and then kicked me off the system over the next several turns. I tried to go hard to the ground, but he flipped and managed to have a lot more fighting power and vehicles so I couldn’t do much. I ended up losing by 15-ish. Kyle’s deck felt like a really hard matchup for the deck.

    2-3

    Game 6: My HITCO vs. Dennis Reinhardt’s HD

    So this game, I grimtaash two Vader’s and play well, but Dennis does too and has better luck. He doesn’t duel me as far as I remember, but gets set up at Mustafar and I don’t draw the Profundity. Since that was my only ship, he is outdamaging me by 2-3 a turn since we both have a BG site. It felt like I should have won because I got spared from Epic Duels, but the system drains did me in. Loss by 10–15. I tell Dennis I hope he finishes 5-3 at least. He was 4-2 after the game.

    2-4

    Game 7: My BHBM vs. Mitch’s YOPS

    Mitch has a headache and is having a rough day. He makes a lot of mistakes this game, so I get in a your destiny loss of 3, and also am able to sense the Hera ship interrupt. I also force push for Ysane early and hold her most of the game for Jyn Erso so I can have an uncontested drain of 3. I get the Finalizer up and going eventually but Mitch heavily fortifies the 2/2 to where I can’t do anything after I set up the downtown plaza. Because of that, his occasional retrieval and poor card efficiency I end up losing by 5 in a game I should have won. But oh well. In all fairness, Snap never hit the table which is big. Or wasn’t in the deck.

    2-5

    So at this point I frustrated because I felt I should have won that game and have gone 0-4 with a good DS deck.

    Game 8: My Hitco vs. Barry’s Watto

    Barry is also having a rough day and this game didn’t go well for him either. My first turn I satm/bp watto and have obi and Leia versus ozzel. I think I would have overflowed Barry for 9, and he , surprisingly to me, concedes.

    3-5

    After that I decide to be lame and go to the room and chill since I’m not great at small talk and hitting up strangers. Got to socialize more and realize 98% of people at events are cool and have similar interests.

    Anywho...the next day I play in the consolation with the same decks. I beat Mitch’s HD again and he has even worse luck and loses badly. I then technically have Clayton beat with BHBM against TRM but can’t get him before time (pretty cool, considering he was around a 1900 rated player back in the decipher era), lose to Lenny’s MAP by 13 because I don’t know how to beat the deck and felt drained (Lenny you’re cool...I wax just not feeling it) and then Barry let me win by 15 against his WYS, either because he really didn’t feel like playing or wanted to be nice and let me get a Ashoka foil (heck yes!!!).

    So in the end it was a great event.

    I talked some to Hayes who is really cool. Previously I only played him in a game. He told me he thought I was good enough to go 4-4 or 5-3 (if I put in the effort, my own words). He could have been being nice, but like Lenny said in his report last year, it means a lot when a really good player tells you you’re not super jabroni tier, lol.

    I also talked a lot to Jacy and Joe who both are cool as all get out. Turns out Jacy is also an engineer (if you see this, let me know your email/screen name/whatever so we can stay in touch) and Joe and I have some stuff in common. They’re both rad and the west coast is lucky to have them.


    Other Props/Slops...???


    Props:

    -Reid’s deck working and going 4-2 (should have been 5-1, for the me) this weekend. Maybe I just need to ask Reid what to play for DS at events or copy all his decks and I’ll get good? Jk.

    -Me for beating decent opponents, including Sersen who is good and will beat named players if he’s slept on, and me almost beating Claydoh (he’s good, Endor results included)...Barry, Hoe, and

    -Hayes, Gogolen, Jerry, and Wirfs because duh

    -Sersen because dude deserves it

    -Seth for helping, even though I went 6-9 on the weekend I was close to going 9-6. If I had just taken the initiative to play more in addition to getting help from you, I could have easily be closer to day 2

    -Getting an Ashoka foil


    Slops:

    -Me for resigning myself to a loss against Lenny

    -Not winning against Mitch or Clayton when I maybe could have (?)

    -Being a hermit at night

    -Not getting a Vader’s Castle AI, that image is sweet!!! Got to get better at SWCCG

    -The weather and not packing a coat

    -Getting a room with no microwave or fridge

    -The shortness of this report

    -Not currently flowing in cash/able to travel to anything until maybe Nationals this summer/fall or more realistically next year , maybe I’ll land a good job soon though...

    -Digging the v-slips/foils and not having a lot of them (good job pc, guess this should be under props)

    -Not being able to time an event so I could go with Jeremy, Mike, Agnos, or Gogolen...ditto for Seth, but since we’re on different continents that’s expected

    -So/so turnout from the Seattle guys who weren’t really good...all the locals should have come...

    -Me being a little too heavy for my tourney shirts still, got to get on it and lose more weight to fix that, okay well for real reasons, but having additional incentives helps

    -Chris, for not letting BFred convince you to team up with him and form team Indiana and finally take on K.T.O.D. (jk)

    Overall I had a blast! Maybe if i improve and cross paths with Joe we can win a team tournament one day. Heh. I want some tourney swag.
    Stephen M.
    Dagobah Region
